name: Torsten Lieberknecht
summary: Torsten Lieberknecht has 2 coaching stints at 2 clubs (68 league games) in the dataset, from 2013/14 to 2023/24. Too thin a record for a grade (grading requires at least 3 stints and 109 league games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was SV Darmstadt 98 2023/24 (+0.02 PPG); the toughest was Eintracht Braunschweig 2013/14 (+0.01 PPG).
